prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t pick a single “best” salon for all people — it depends on whether you want a spray (sunless) tan or UV beds, your skin type, budget, and which Columbus neighborhood you’re near. I don’t have live web access to check current reviews, but here’s how to find the best option quickly and safely, plus a couple of reliable national chains you’ll see in Columbus.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific salons:
- Do you want a spray (airbrush) tan or a UV bed tan?
- Which part of Columbus or what ZIP code are you closest to?
- Any budget or membership preference?

If you want a fast answer right now
- Chains to consider (multiple Columbus locations): Palm Beach Tan and Sun Tan City — consistent equipment, membership options, and lots of customer reviews to compare.
- For spray/airbrush tans, look for boutique studios that advertise “airbrush” or “professional spray” and list technician training.

How to pick the best salon
1. Read recent Google/Yelp reviews (last 6–12 months) for cleanliness, staff professionalism, and fade quality.  
2. For spray tans: confirm technicians use trained airbrush application, show before/after photos, and offer a patch test if you have sensitive skin.  
3. For UV tanning: check the type of beds (high-pressure vs. low-pressure), age of equipment, session time options, and whether they follow safety/eye-protection protocols. (Note: dermatologists advise avoiding UV tanning due to skin cancer risk.)  
4. Visit in person (or call) to check cleanliness, smell (no chemical overload), availability of disposable eye protection, and whether staff explain aftercare.  
5. Compare prices, membership plans, and first-time specials — many salons run good intro deals.

If you tell me spray vs UV and what neighborhood/ZIP you’re in, I’ll suggest 3–5 specific salons in Columbus to check and what to ask them.
